Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region. This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience. The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience. Key Deliverables Include Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results. Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans. Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions. Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations. Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders. Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives. Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results. Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget. Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities. Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels. Post-secondary education with a business application an asset. Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously. Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook. Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time. Project management skills considered an asset. Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset. Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams. IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Weâre Canadaâs leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians. Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2. Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. The team agreesâ our employee NPS is in the high 80s. About The Role As a Sales Development Representative, your primary responsibility will be to secure meetings with top prospective companies and individuals. You'll work closely with one paired Account Executive to generate meetings from their target account list. We encourage account development through outbound prospecting, social selling, networking, attending conferences and field marketing events, and any sales activity that would contribute to expanding the Tremendous brand. You will be the first line of engagement with prospective customers and will have an impact on Tremendousâ revenue growth and future success. What You'll Do Work primarily to bring in new deals through Outbound prospecting. Use Outreach, LinkedIn, your own network, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you. What's Cool About The Role You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. Weâre profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. Thatâs good news for your career growth.
